landing.eyebrow: Built in the UAE, for the UAE
landing.title: An AI teammate that speaks your customers' Arabic
landing.subtitle: Train a bilingual chatbot on your menu, prices and policies. Deploy it on your website and WhatsApp in minutes. It understands Emirati dialect, Arabizi and voice notes — and hands over to your team the moment it isn't sure.

dialects.title: Fluent Khaleeji
dialects.body: Replies in Emirati, Levantine or formal Arabic, Arabizi and English — mirroring how each customer writes.

voice.title: Voice notes
voice.body: Customers send Arabic voice notes on WhatsApp or the widget; Whisper transcribes them and the bot answers.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp Cloud API
whatsapp.body: Connect your business number and answer customers where they already are.

knowledge.title: Your own knowledge
knowledge.body: Upload menus, price lists, return policies and FAQs. Answers are grounded in your data — never guessed.

handoff.title: Confident or it hands off
handoff.body: Low confidence, frustration or a request for a manager instantly routes the chat to a person with an AI summary.

inbox.title: Live team inbox
inbox.body: Agents see handoffs in real time, take over, reply, and hand back to the AI when done.

landing.footer: © KhaleejiBot. Made for businesses across the seven emirates.
